etymologies.etymologyHTML: From dis- +‎ approve.

definitions.definition: (intransitive) To condemn; to consider wrong or inappropriate; used with of.

quote.text: The nationalist not only does not disapprove of atrocities committed by his own side, but he has a remarkable capacity for not even hearing about them.

definitions.definition: To have or express an unfavorable opinion. (Can we add an example for this sense?)
